module_summary: 10GBASE-R PHY top instantiating independent TX (XGMII to 64b/66b encode, scramble, SERDES) and RX (SERDES block lock, descramble, decode to XGMII) paths in separate clock domains.

anchors.name: xgmii_txd
anchors.why: XGMII transmit data entering the TX encoder path.

anchors.name: xgmii_txc
anchors.why: XGMII transmit control lanes selecting block types.

anchors.name: xgmii_rxd
anchors.why: Decoded XGMII receive data from the RX path.

anchors.name: serdes_tx_data
anchors.why: Scrambled 64b payload driven to the SERDES transmitter.

anchors.name: serdes_tx_hdr
anchors.why: 66b sync header for each transmitted block.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_data
anchors.why: Received 64b payload from SERDES into the RX path.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_hdr
anchors.why: Received sync header used for block lock.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_bitslip
anchors.why: Bitslip request to SERDES during block-lock alignment.

anchors.name: rx_status
anchors.why: Overall receive link status (locked and not high BER).

anchors.name: serdes_rx_reset_req
anchors.why: Requests SERDES receiver reset on loss of lock.

anchors.name: rx_high_ber
anchors.why: High bit-error-rate indication from BER monitor.

anchors.name: cfg_tx_prbs31_enable
anchors.why: Enables PRBS31 test pattern on transmit.

groups.name: PHY transmit path
groups.description: 64b/66b encoder and scrambler from XGMII to SERDES.

groups.name: PHY receive path
groups.description: Block lock, descrambler, BER monitor and decoder to XGMII.
